- Sergio will follow up with an ops runbook and migration window options.
- Procurement & legal (your side) to confirm timeline for signatures — we can DocuSign SOW once procurement confirms P.O. or signature window.
- Schedule a kickoff QBR: please pick one of the suggested slots below.

Suggested QBR slots (PDT):
1) Friday, Jul 6 — 10:00–11:00
2) Monday, Jul 9 — 13:00–14:00
3) Tuesday, Jul 10 — 09:00–10:00
